data.title: HRH the Crown Prince Congratulates President of Lebanon on Independence Day
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- His Royal Highness Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Crown Prince and Prime Minister, has sent a cable of congratulations to President of the Republic of Lebanon Joseph Aoun on his country’s Independence Day.
    HRH the Crown Prince wished the president continued good health and happiness, and the government and people of Lebanon steady progress and prosperity.
    -- SPA
12:58 Local Time 09:58 GMT
